name: TS Mahou Shoujo Nao!
source:
"For real... I'm a magical girl...!?"

Nao Amagi's life as a male student at Wizard School is already pretty weird.
But when he gets turned into a girl...
The absurd transgender comedy ADV with rousing magical battles begins now!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133220.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“不是吧……我是魔法少女……！？”

天城尚作为魔法学校的男学生，生活已经够奇怪了。
但当他变成女孩后……
荒诞的变性喜剧ADV与热血魔法战斗，现在开幕！

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133220.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
